newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU agrees to acquire Equifax unit.
newsitem.headline: VNU agrees to acquire Equifax unit.

text.p: Dutch publisher NV Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Friday its VNU USA unit had signed a letter of intent to take over National Decision Systems (NDS), part of Atlanta-based information services firm Equifax .
VNU said in a statement both parties expected to come to a definitive agreement at the end of May.
It said NDS, based in San Diego, is active in marketing information services which fit in well with those of VNU Marketing Information Services operations.
NDS had a turnover of around $39 million in 1996 and employs around 250 people.

The statement said VNU and Equifax had also agreed a cooperation pact for the next 10 years which would give VNU access to Equifax's consumer credit databases, while Equifax would be able to add VNU MIS's market analysis expertise to its product range.
